summary: Previous-tick pose capture for Transform3D, enabling interpolated rendering.
useWhen: Any game whose entities move in 3D (or 2D on a plane) and are drawn by std/render-sync or simulated by std/physics-rapier.
limitations: Pose only; velocity lives in physics or your own component.
Parent links are resolved on read (worldPose); deep hierarchies cost O(depth) per lookup.
